This plot is very small, only a small piece behind the house, but maize is our food so I must do what I can. I went to school for a few years so I know the fertilizer helps, and last year I got the subsidy coupon for one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — I am hoping for the same this year, otherwise I cannot afford to buy at the agro-dealer price. I will put the chickens' droppings and the kitchen ash on the plot before planting, and I will buy a small packet of hybrid seed because my neighbor's harvest was much better with it. I have intercropped beans with the maize like always, so I do not spray anything, and I have no way to bring water — I wait for the rain.
